title: Please Save My Earth
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shy high-schooler Alice Sakaguchi, newly moved to Tokyo, babysits her bratty seven-year-old neighbor Rin. She and several classmates discover they share dreams of past lives as alien scientists who watched Earth from a moonbase, and what starts as a game turns dark as the memories reveal love triangles, jealousy and betrayal. After an accidental fall, Rin returns with adult maturity, psychic powers and an obsessive fixation on Alice. A 21-volume classic shoujo science-fiction series.
life_message: The past can inform who you are, but you must choose to live in the present rather than repeat old wounds.

folkways.japan: Shoujo conventions of the 1980s (reincarnation romance, flower and plant symbolism) and Japanese interest in rinne (rebirth) shape the premise.

delivery.evidence: ANN's Jason Thompson says the environmental theme is not preachy and character comes before moralizing.

personified.ideology: cynicism born of war and loss

delivery.note: The cynical war orphan's view gets a full backstory rather than simple condemnation, per ANN.

winners_losers: The dreamers who let go of past-life grudges gain freedom; obsession is shown as destructive; sympathy is spread across the cast, including Rin.
